characterization_methods.key_findings: XCT slice shows dendritic particles of varying size on a rounded cross-section; dark precipitate phase (dendrite) in the foreground, located in the center of the circular region.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: image resolution 852×852 pixels; real size (field of view) 1380×1380 µm; 2 test images; public dataset AZA [25]
characterization_methods.purpose: Acquire XCT slices of AlZn alloy dendrite for phase segmentation evaluation
Quantitatively evaluate phase segmentation performance on the AZA dataset (IoU, F1, Recall)
characterization_methods.technique: Microstructure phase segmentation evaluation (MatSAM vs SAM / OTSU / Adaptive thresholding / specialist DL model)

comparative_performance.improvement_percentage: MatSAM IoU 0.96 (±0.6%), slightly lower than the specialist method (0.97); higher than SAM (0.73 ±6.8%), OTSU (0.89 ±1.2%), and Adaptive thresholding (0.61 ±2.3%)

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: IoU under salt-and-pepper (S&P) noise at Var. = 0.00, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20
comparative_performance.improvement_percentage: MatSAM IoU declines from 0.946 to 0.815 (0.946, 0.913, 0.879, 0.861, 0.815); SAM declines from 0.903 to 0.776 (0.903, 0.884, 0.814, 0.819, 0.776); MatSAM higher than SAM at every noise level

phases_present.morphology: dendritic particles of varying size on a rounded cross-section; dark angular internal phases

precipitates.distribution: located in the center of the circular region (foreground)

structures.overall_structure: AlZn alloy dendrite; dark precipitate phase (dendrite) in the foreground, located in the center of the circular region to be segmented; classified as polycrystalline & multiphase

unmapped_findings: On AZA images, the round circle boundary is unexpectedly detected by OTSU, Canny, and Watershed because edge-detection methods are sensitive to the circle's strongly contrasting boundary and OTSU includes the low gray-value boundary as foreground during thresholding; MatSAM suppresses this boundary by focusing on meaningful regions rather than abrupt edges.
AZA is a public dataset [25] (solid border in Fig. 1), classified as 'Polycrystalline & Multiphase' and assigned to the 'phase' segmentation task with 2 test images.
MatSAM ranked second on AZA among the public datasets, slightly lower than the corresponding specialist DL model trained on over 1000 annotated image samples (IoU 0.96 vs 0.97).
